info.title: CourseCI API
info.description: CourseCI backend API for the Vue SPA and Android application.

patch.description: Partially updates an active assignment in an active owned course. Omitted fields are preserved; optional fields may be cleared. After any submission exists, maximum score and opening date cannot change (422). Title, description, and deadline remain editable.

get.description: Available to the owning teacher and enrolled students. The assignment must belong to the course in the URL. Includes archived assignments for historical access.

delete.description: Archives an assignment in an active owned course without deleting submissions, grades, or journal history. Repeated requests preserve the original archive timestamp.

get.description: Available to the owning teacher and enrolled students. Returns a paginated collection; status accepts active (default), archived, or all. Manual grade items are excluded.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description: Creates an assignment and journal grade item in an active owned course. Dates are nullable and normalized to UTC; a deadline must follow the opening date. Maximum score is positive with at most two decimal places. Go grading checks are fixed and cannot be configured.

patch.description: Updates an active course owned by the authenticated teacher.

get.description: Available to the owning teacher and enrolled students, including for archived courses.

delete.description: Archives an owned course without deleting its history.

get.description: Teachers receive owned courses; students receive courses in which they are enrolled. Active courses are returned by default.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description: Creates a new course owned by the authenticated teacher.

get.description: Sets the XSRF-TOKEN cookie required by stateful SPA requests.
Accepts either an SPA session or a mobile bearer token.
Lists students enrolled in a course owned by the authenticated teacher.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description: Enrolls an existing student account by email in an active owned course.

delete.description: Removes access to an active course while preserving submissions and grades.

post.description: Creates a student account without starting a session.
Requires a Sanctum CSRF cookie and matching X-XSRF-TOKEN header.

parameters.name: X-XSRF-TOKEN
parameters.description: Decoded value of the XSRF-TOKEN cookie.

delete.description: Requires the current SPA session and X-XSRF-TOKEN header.

parameters.name: X-XSRF-TOKEN
parameters.description: Decoded value of the XSRF-TOKEN cookie.

get.description: The course owner sees every student attempt; students see only their own. Students retain access to their own history after enrollment removal. Optional status filter accepts queued, running, passed, failed, timed_out, or system_error.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description: An enrolled student submits an HTTPS GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket owner/repository URL during the assignment window. Requires an Idempotency-Key UUID header: a new key creates an attempt (201), a retry with the same key and canonical URL returns the original (200), and a conflicting URL returns 409. Saves the attempt, initial grading run, and database job atomically. Repository visibility and existence are verified by the Phase 8 runner, not this endpoint.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A new UUID per intended attempt. Reuse it for retries of that attempt.

200.description: Previously accepted submission returned for an idempotent retry.

201.description: Submission, initial grading run, and grading job created.

409.description: Idempotency key already used for a different repository URL.

get.description: Available only to the submitting student and the course owner. Includes the latest grading result, grading-run history, and a grade when one references this attempt. Internal runner metadata is omitted.

post.description: Creates a Sanctum bearer token for the named mobile device.

delete.description: Revokes the bearer token used for this request.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
